correctness.rationale: For repairs/3/RESULT.md, the two x₀ supporting faces and the binary coordinates show all listed points are vertices. The same-sign distance is |I△J|; after removing the diagonal, dividing by two and counting both sign copies gives A_n−F_{n+2}. In a cross-sign unordered pair the plus and minus endpoints distinguish roles, giving q⁴ B_n, not twice that term. The finite formulas specialize from the cited endpoint-weight refinement, including n=0. The fixed-boundary transfer has primitive base matrix at q=1 since every state connects through 00. A simple analytic dominant eigenvalue gives the normalized cumulant expansion uniformly near θ=0. The stationary-chain tilt is similar to the same normalized transfer, so its first two limiting cumulants are the required derivatives. The product of two Fibonacci chains has p=(5−√5)/10 and correlation ratio −φ⁻²; expanding the local costs into the two centered coordinates and their product yields the stated means and summable covariances. This establishes both Gaussian limits; the same-sign diagonal exclusion vanishes exponentially and the constant cross-sign offset 4 is negligible. Branch weights tend to one half and the two means are distinct. Independent replay (python /workspace/checks/reproduce.py 3) compares direct signed-coordinate distances with both rational formulas for n=0..7 and differentiates the Perron cubic symbolically at q=1 to verify all four constants by a separate route. Finite enumeration is corroboration only.
